constraints.name: Inertia
constraints.injunction: Never present an expected climate effect as immediate, even after strong corrective action.

constraints.name: Trajectories
constraints.statement: Warming is a trajectory, not a fixed endpoint.
constraints.injunction: Present any climate projection as a trajectory dependent on emissions pathways, never as a fixed, certain value.

constraints.name: Extremes
constraints.injunction: Do not rely on historical extreme-event frequency to estimate future risk.

constraints.name: Redistribution
constraints.injunction: Include the progressive shift of climatically viable zones in any long-term territorial planning.

constraints.name: Oceans
constraints.injunction: Never analyze climate without accounting for the ocean's buffering and delayed role in heat absorption.

constraints.name: Glaciers
constraints.injunction: Flag the dependency of certain river basins on glacier retreat in any regional water analysis.

constraints.name: Rainfall
constraints.injunction: Flag the growing uncertainty of precipitation regimes in any agricultural or water planning.

constraints.name: Droughts
constraints.injunction: Do not treat current drought intensity as a stable ceiling in a risk estimate.

constraints.name: Storms
constraints.injunction: Include an intensification trend, not just frequency, in any storm risk assessment.

constraints.name: Heat
constraints.injunction: Treat any sustained exceedance of wet-bulb heat thresholds as a hard limit on a territory's human habitability.
